sentences.en: I read a short story about time travel last night.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚读了一篇关于时间旅行的短篇小说。

sentences.en: Her first published work was a short story in a magazine.
sentences.zh: 她第一篇公开发表的作品是一本杂志上的短篇小说。

sentences.en: He wrote the short story as part of his creative writing class assignment.
sentences.zh: 他写这篇短篇小说作为创意写作课的作业。
